lines.text: 材料与堆栈：光学匹配还要服从界面
lines.zh: 材料与堆栈：光学匹配还要服从界面
lines.en: Materials and stacks: optical matching must also satisfy interface requirements

lines.text: 有机BARC/ 无机ARC/ 水溶性TARC / Topcoat
lines.zh: 有机BARC/ 无机ARC/ 水溶性TARC / Topcoat
lines.en: Organic BARC / inorganic ARC / water-soluble TARC / Topcoat

lines.text: 材料不仅要满足n/k，还要兼容光刻胶、衬底、显影和刻蚀。
lines.zh: 材料不仅要满足n/k，还要兼容光刻胶、衬底、显影和刻蚀。
lines.en: Materials must satisfy n/k requirements and remain compatible with photoresist, substrates, development and etching.

lines.text: 多层材料协同满足光学、界面与工艺需求
lines.zh: 多层材料协同满足光学、界面与工艺需求
lines.en: Multiple materials jointly meet optical, interface and process requirements

lines.text: 不同材料体系各有优势，需结合工艺与器件需求选择
lines.zh: 不同材料体系各有优势，需结合工艺与器件需求选择
lines.en: Each material system has advantages; select according to process and device requirements
• Can also serve as a hard mask
• Can also function as a hard mask
Not every Topcoat is a TARC

lines.text: TARC具有明确的抗反射光学功能。
lines.zh: TARC具有明确的抗反射光学功能。
lines.en: TARC has an explicit optical antireflection function.

lines.text: 材料需在完整工艺流程中保持性能与稳定性
lines.zh: 材料需在完整工艺流程中保持性能与稳定性
lines.en: Materials must maintain performance and stability throughout the process

lines.text: 材料选择与工艺窗口需要同时满足以下关键点
lines.zh: 材料选择与工艺窗口需要同时满足以下关键点
lines.en: Material selection and process windows must satisfy these key requirements together

lines.text: 不同材料体系存在优势与集成挑战
lines.zh: 不同材料体系存在优势与集成挑战
lines.en: Different material systems have distinct advantages and integration challenges
• Easy spin coating and strong planarization

lines.text: • 适合复杂地形和细结构
lines.zh: • 适合复杂地形和细结构
lines.en: • Suitable for complex topography and fine structures
• Solvents in upper layers must not damage
• Layer processes must not interfere with one another

lines.text: • 适合大面积与复杂地形
lines.zh: • 适合大面积与复杂地形
lines.en: • Suitable for large areas and complex topography

lines.text: • 可兼顾抗反射与硬掩膜
lines.zh: • 可兼顾抗反射与硬掩膜

lines.text: • 对界面与工艺匹配要求高
lines.zh: • 对界面与工艺匹配要求高

lines.text: 材料与工艺不匹配会带来多种良率风险
lines.zh: 材料与工艺不匹配会带来多种良率风险
lines.en: Material–process mismatch can create multiple yield risks

lines.text: 通过多维量测验证材料与界面状态
lines.zh: 通过多维量测验证材料与界面状态
lines.en: Verify material and interface conditions using multiple measurements

lines.text: 部分SiARC/ Underlayer兼具抗反射与图形转移功能，ARC不只是光学层。
lines.zh: 部分SiARC/ Underlayer兼具抗反射与图形转移功能，ARC不只是光学层。
lines.en: Some SiARC / underlayers combine antireflection and pattern-transfer functions; ARC is more than an optical layer.
